$comment: Brand-and-claim rules for cosmocrew.dev (luvita-docs#9, EmirErs W7). Run after `npm run build:web`: python3 .github/scripts/brand-check.py. Schema: https://github.com/AnunnakiCosmoCrew/project-templates/tree/main/actions/brand-claim-check

rules.pattern: (©|©) 20\d{2} CosmoCrew (—|—) a brand of ]*\shref="https://luvita\.tr/"[^>]*>Luvita Teknoloji Ltd\. (Ş|Ş)ti\.
rules.why: CLAUDE.md / luvita-docs ADR 0001: every page carries `© {year} CosmoCrew — a brand of Luvita Teknoloji Ltd. Şti.` in server-sent HTML, with the entity as the link text and https://luvita.tr/ as the target (rule inventory 57; the defect that cost case #00302760). Case-sensitive; the built HTML may carry © / — / Ş as entities, so both forms are accepted, and the anchor's real href must be luvita.tr.
ADR 0001: `© CosmoCrew` leads and is never replaced by `© Luvita`; the copyright holder is never a person.
CLAUDE.md: never route the attribution through another site; one hop is not enough.
CLAUDE.md: short form of the company name only; the full trade name contains "Enerji" and belongs in legal-identity blocks on luvita.tr (luvita-web/adr/0003; rule inventory 56).
CLAUDE.md: do not list Luvita's non-CosmoCrew products (Umay, Luvi Engine, Pelerin) here; that is luvita.tr's job and Pelerin is in stealth (rule inventory 58).
LUVITA.md, Brands: LexiPower never "WordPower", Umay never "Yaren" in public (rule inventory 58).
adr/0002: the public site contains zero private metrics data and zero gating logic; metricsEnabled is never rendered.
adr/0002 / adr/0003: the metrics dashboard is a separate, authenticated application on its own subdomain, never part of the GitHub Pages build.
LUVITA.md, Legal entity: the registered office is the founder's home; the street address is never published on our own surfaces (rule inventory 54/118).
LUVITA.md, Copy rules (CosmoCrew voice): feel indie and ambitious without saying it; avoid "small", "indie", "humble", "modest". Reported for review, since the words have innocent uses.
